Staff Product Manager, AI
Corvid Labs
Location: San Francisco, CA (hybrid)

Responsibilities:
- Own the strategy and roadmap for our LLM-powered assistant.
- Ship production AI features with ML and platform engineering.
- Define evaluation criteria, guardrails and quality metrics for model outputs.
- Drive adoption with enterprise customers and measure business outcomes.
- Influence executives and lead product direction across multiple teams.

Requirements:
- 8+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on AI or ML products.
- Experience shipping LLM features to production.
- Strong technical fluency: APIs, data pipelines, model evaluation.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers and data scientists.
- Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation or agents.
- Background in enterprise SaaS.
